projects.name: agent-desktop
projects.description: Computer use CLI for AI agents
projects.readmeExcerpt: agent desktop Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree. agent desktop gives an AI agent computer use without screenshots or pixel matching. It reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON, with a ref for every element the agent can act on. The agent clicks or types on a ref, reads the UI again to check the result, and repeats. The loop lives in your agent; agent desktop has no model inside. It ships as a CLI and a C library. Snapshots, clipboard reads, screenshots, command output, and debug artifacts can contain private desktop content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads. Install Bun, Yarn and pnpm can install the same package. It includes native binaries and platform helpers for x64 and ARM64. For direct execution without a JavaScript launcher, download the matching native archiv

projects.readmeExcerpt: Worktrunk November 2026 : Worktrunk was released at the start of the year, and has quickly become the most popular git worktree manager. It's built with love (there's no slop!). projects.name: colibri
projects.description: A hierarchical inference engine for frontier MoE models: hot experts on the GPU (CUDA, Vulkan), warm ones in RAM, cold ones streamed from NVMe. Written in C, runs on the hardware you already own.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Website · Discord · English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · Italiano · 日本語 · Bahasa Indonesia · Português (Brasil) Tiny engine, immense model. colibri runs very large open models on the machine you already have. A mixture of experts model of hundreds of billions of parameters uses only a small part of itself for each token, so colibri keeps that part in RAM and reads the rest, the experts, from the disk when the model asks for them. Pure C, one file per model family, no GPU required. Thirteen engines run today. Ten are for language models: GLM 5.2/5.3 (which also runs Mistral Large 4 ), GLM 5.3 Flash , Inkling , Kimi K3 , DeepSeek V4 Flash , DeepSeek V4.1 Flash , MiMo V2.6 Flash (and Pro), Qwen3.8 Flash Next , Qwen3.6 (which also runs Qwen3 Coder, the dense Qwen3.8 27B, Flint , Muse Spark Open and LFM3 VL ) and OLMoE . One draws pictures: Qwen Image 2.1 . Two answer decisions: Laya and GLiNER2.5 Decide
